note: Speech-to-text bench (owner 2026-10-05: "do the new speech-to-text bench"): his voice notes as Telegram sends them (OGG/Opus), made by Gemini TTS in male voices with laughs, a sigh, a whisper, Levantine Arabic, Arabizi code-switching and a heavy accent; each heard by Whisper (live), Nova-3 and OpenRouter's audio-input models. Judge: words right, Arabic right, sounds/tone noted.

lines.instructions: A relaxed man in his late twenties talking to his girlfriend, amused. Laugh out loud where marked.
lines.text: [laughs] No way, you actually said that to him? [laughs] Okay, okay, I'm coming over.

lines.instructions: A tired man after a long day, low and slow, a long audible sigh where marked.
lines.text: [sighs] Long day. My boss kept me late again... I just want to lie down and hear your voice.

lines.instructions: A man whispering close to the phone, teasing.
lines.text: [whispers] Don't tell anyone... but I've been thinking about you all day.

lines.instructions: A Lebanese man speaking natural Levantine Arabic, warm and casual.
lines.text: كيفك حبيبتي؟ اشتقتلك كتير. شو عم تعملي هلق؟

lines.instructions: A Lebanese man mixing Arabic and English mid-sentence, playful and a little impatient, with a Lebanese accent.
lines.text: Habibti, yalla, open the door, ana barra, I'm literally standing outside, khalas!

lines.instructions: A man with a heavy Arabic accent speaking English, annoyed then laughing at himself at the end.
lines.text: I am so tired of this weather, honestly. Every day rain, rain, rain. I want to go back home to the sun. [laughs]

prompt: This is a voice note a man sent to his girlfriend on Telegram. Transcribe it exactly as spoken: English in English, Arabic in Arabic script, Arabizi or mixed words as he says them. Put non-speech sounds and tone in parentheses where they happen, for example (laughs), (sighs), (whispering), (teasing), (annoyed). Output only the transcript.
